title: GitHub Copilot License: Plans, Seat Prices and AI Credits

facts.fact: GitHub lists the Copilot Pro plan at $10 USD per month for individuals, per the wiki's price list as of 2026-10-07.
facts.quote: Copilot Pro | Individual | $10 USD per month

facts.fact: GitHub lists the Copilot Pro+ plan at $39 USD per month for individuals, per the wiki's price list as of 2026-10-07.
facts.quote: Copilot Pro+ | Individual | $39 USD per month

facts.fact: GitHub lists the Copilot Max plan at $100 USD per month for individuals, per the wiki's price list as of 2026-10-07.
facts.quote: Copilot Max | Individual | $100 USD per month

facts.fact: GitHub lists the Copilot Business plan at $19 USD per granted seat per month for organizations and enterprises.
facts.unit: USD per granted seat per month
facts.quote: Copilot Business | Organizations and enterprises | $19 USD per granted seat per month

facts.fact: GitHub lists the Copilot Enterprise plan at $39 USD per granted seat per month for enterprises on GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
facts.unit: USD per granted seat per month
facts.quote: Copilot Enterprise | Enterprises on GitHub Enterprise Cloud | $39 USD per granted seat per month

facts.fact: The page states that Copilot Free and Copilot Student are listed at a price of free, with their AI credit allowance amount not stated.
facts.quote: Copilot Student | Verified students | Free | An allowance (amount not stated)

facts.fact: Per GitHub documentation cited on the page, 1 AI credit equals $0.01 USD.
facts.quote: 1 AI credit equals $0.01 USD

facts.fact: The Copilot Pro plan includes 1,500 AI credits per month, made up of 1,000 base and 500 flex credits.
facts.quote: Copilot Pro | Individual | $10 USD per month | 1,500 (1,000 base + 500 flex)

facts.fact: The Copilot Pro+ plan includes 7,000 AI credits per month, made up of 3,900 base and 3,100 flex credits.
facts.quote: Copilot Pro+ | Individual | $39 USD per month | 7,000 (3,900 base + 3,100 flex)

facts.fact: The Copilot Max plan includes 20,000 AI credits per month, made up of 10,000 base and 10,000 flex credits.
facts.quote: Copilot Max | Individual | $100 USD per month | 20,000 (10,000 base + 10,000 flex)

facts.fact: The Copilot Business plan includes 1,900 AI credits per user per month, pooled.
facts.unit: AI credits per user per month
facts.quote: Copilot Business | Organizations and enterprises | $19 USD per granted seat per month | 1,900 per user, pooled

facts.fact: The Copilot Enterprise plan includes 3,900 AI credits per user per month, pooled.
facts.unit: AI credits per user per month
facts.quote: Copilot Enterprise | Enterprises on GitHub Enterprise Cloud | $39 USD per granted seat per month | 3,900 per user, pooled

facts.fact: GitHub lists seven Copilot plans.
facts.quote: GitHub lists seven Copilot plans.

facts.fact: The wiki records no published seat minimum for Copilot, and Enterprise requires GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
facts.quote: No published seat minimum; Enterprise requires GitHub Enterprise Cloud

facts.fact: Copilot is not currently available for GitHub Enterprise Server.
facts.quote: Copilot is not currently available for GitHub Enterprise Server.

facts.fact: Copilot Pro is free for verified teachers and maintainers of popular open source projects, according to GitHub's billing documentation cited on the page.
facts.quote: Copilot Pro is free for verified teachers and maintainers of popular open source projects

facts.fact: Organizations and enterprises are billed for the number of assigned Copilot seats at the end of each monthly billing cycle.
facts.quote: Organizations and enterprises are billed for the number of assigned seats at the end of each monthly billing cycle.

facts.fact: A user holding seats in several organizations of the same enterprise is billed once per billing cycle.
facts.quote: A user who holds seats in several organizations of the same enterprise is billed once per cycle.

facts.fact: If a user holds both a Business and an Enterprise seat, only the Enterprise seat is billed, at the Enterprise rate from the time it was assigned.
facts.quote: If a user holds both a Business and an Enterprise seat, only the Enterprise seat is billed, at the Enterprise rate from the time it was assigned.

facts.fact: Seats added mid-cycle are billed for the rest of the cycle, prorated by the date added.
facts.quote: Seats added mid-cycle are billed for the rest of the cycle, prorated by the date added.

facts.fact: Removing every assigned seat in an organization cancels the organization's Copilot plan.
facts.quote: removing every assigned seat cancels the organization’s Copilot plan.

facts.fact: The Copilot model token metric is priced per 1 million tokens by model, covering input, cached input, cache write where applicable, and output, and drives AI credit conversion.
facts.quote: per-model prices per 1 million tokens (input, cached input, cache write where applicable, output)

facts.fact: The GitHub pricing page still names a legacy 'Premium request paid usage' policy, but the retrieved plan and billing pages show no premium request allowance.
facts.quote: The pricing page still names a legacy “Premium request paid usage” policy

facts.fact: Copilot is licensed per user: individuals subscribe to a personal plan billed per calendar month, while organizations and enterprises pay for each granted seat.
facts.quote: Individuals subscribe to a personal plan billed per calendar month, while organizations and enterprises buy Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise and pay for each granted seat.
